Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 5. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 6. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 15 days time limit. seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 7. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of Work The contractor shall undertake the complete supply, installation and commissioning of the synthetic badmi nton court, including flooring system, court markings, accessories and all allied works as specified in the a pproved scope/specifications. Site Inspection The contractor shall inspect the site and verify all dimensions, levels, existing surface conditions and other site requirements before commencing the work. No additional claim arising from failure to inspect the site shall ordinarily be entertained. Technical Specifications All materials shall be of approved quality and conform to the specifications, relevant standards and approv ed samples. The synthetic surface shall be suitable for outdoor badminton use and designed for durability, weather resistance and safe play. Base Preparation The contractor shall ensure that the existing/base surface is properly prepared, levelled, cleaned and mad e suitable for installation of the synthetic flooring. Any defects affecting the performance of the court shall be rectified before installation. Synthetic Flooring The flooring shall be installed strictly in accordance with the manufacturer's recommended procedure. The surface shall be properly bonded, jointed and finished without bubbles, loose areas, unevenness or other v isible defects. Court Dimensions & Markings The badminton court shall be provided with accurate dimensions and professional-quality line markings as per the applicable badminton rules/standards. Court lines shall be straight, uniform and clearly visible. Badminton Equipment Posts, net, antennas, referee stand and other accessories, wherever included in the scope, shall be of suita ble quality and installed securely and accurately. Material Approval The contractor shall submit product details, technical data sheets, samples and manufacturer information, wherever required, for approval before procurement/installation. No material shall be substituted without prior approval. Workmanship All works shall be carried out by suitably skilled personnel using proper tools and equipment. The complet ed court shall have a neat, uniform and professional finish.

Quality Inspection The purchaser/authorized representative shall have the right to inspect materials and workmanship at any stage. Any defective or non-conforming work shall be rectified/replaced by the contractor at no additional cost. Time for Completion The work shall be completed within the stipulated period mentioned in the work order/contract. Any delay attributable to the contractor may attract applicable contractual provisions/liquidated damages. Warranty/Defect Liability The contractor shall provide a minimum warranty/defect liability period as specified in the work order. Any manufacturing or installation defect occurring during this period, under normal use, shall be rectified by th e contractor without additional cost. Protection of Completed Work The contractor shall protect the completed surface from damage until formal handover. Any damage caus ed due to the contractor's activities shall be repaired at the contractor's cost. Safety & Labour Compliance The contractor shall be responsible for the safety of its workers and personnel at the site and shall comply with all applicable labour, safety and statutory requirements. Cleanliness & Disposal The contractor shall keep the work area clean and shall remove construction waste, packaging material an d debris generated during the work before final handover. Payment Payment shall be made as per the terms specified in the work order/contract and shall be subject to satisf actory completion, inspection and acceptance of the work. Taxes & Duties All applicable taxes, duties, transportation, loading/unloading, labour, tools, installation charges and other incidental expenses shall be dealt with as specified in the tender/work order. No Subletting The contractor shall not assign or sublet the complete work or any substantial part thereof without prior wr itten approval of the purchaser. Final Acceptance Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory completion of the entire scope, rectification of deficiencies and submission of required warranty/product documents. Compliance with Applicable Standards The contractor shall comply with applicable national/international standards and recognized volleyball spe cifications wherever specified in the tender or approved technical specification. Right to Reject The purchaser reserves the right to reject materials or workmanship that do not conform to the approved s pecifications, quality requirements or agreed standards. Dispute Resolution Any dispute arising out of the contract shall first be resolved amicably between the parties. Failing such re solution, the matter shall be dealt with in accordance with the dispute-resolution provisions of the contract /work order. General Any matter not specifically covered under these terms and conditions shall be governed by the provisions of the tender/work order and applicable rules and regulations of the purchaser. Quality Assurance. Seller would provide the standard Acceptance Test Procedure (ATP) within 120 days of this date of contract. Buyer reserves the right to modify the ATP. Seller would be required to provide all test facilities at his premises for acceptance and inspection by buyer. The details in this regard will be coo rdinated during the negotiation of the contract. The item should be of the latest manufacture, conforming t o the current production standard and having 100% defined life at the time of delivery. Warranty. The following Warranty will form part of the contract placed on successful Bidder:–

(a) The Seller warrants that the goods supplied under the contract conform to technical specifications prescribed and shall perform according to the said technical specifications. (b) The Seller warrants for a period of 36 months from the date of acceptance of stores by Joint Recei pt Inspection or date of installation and commissioning, whichever is later, that the goods/stores supplied under the contract and each component used in the manufacture thereof shall be free from all types of de fects/failures (c) If within the period of warranty, the goods are reported by the Buyer to have failed to perform as pe r the specifications, the Seller shall either replace or rectify the same free of charge, within a maximum per iod of 45 days of notification of such defect received by the Seller, provided that the goods are used and m aintained by the Buyer as per instructions contained in the Operating Manual. Warranty of the equipment would be extended by such duration of downtime. Record of the down time would be maintained by the us er in the logbook. Spares required for warranty repairs shall be provided free of cost by the Seller. The Sell er also undertakes to diagnose, test, adjust, calibrate and repair/replace the goods/equipment arising due to accidents by neglect or misuse by the operator or damage due to transportation of the goods during the warranty period, at the cost mutually agreed to between the Buyer and the Seller. (d) The Seller also warrants that necessary service and repair back up during the warranty period of th e equipment shall be provided by the Seller. (e) The Seller shall associate technical personnel of the Maintenance agency and QualityAssurance Agency of the Buyer during warranty repair and shall also provide the details of c omplete defects, reasons and remedial actions for defects. (f) If a particular equipment/goods fails frequently and/or, the cumulative down time exceeds 50 % of t he warranty period, the complete equipment shall be replaced free of cost by the Seller within a stipulated period of 20 days of receipt of the notification from the Buyer. Warranty of the replaced equipment would s tart from the date of acceptance after Joint Receipt Inspection by the Buyer/date of installation and commi ssioning. (g) In case the complete delivery of Engineering Support Package is delayed beyond the period stipulat ed in this contract, the Seller undertakes that the warranty period for the goods/stores shall be extended t o that extent. (h) The Seller will guarantee the shelf life of (07) years under the Indian tropical condition as given bel ow:- (i) Minimum temperature: (-) 10 Degree C. (ii) Maximum temperature: 50 Degree C. (iii) Average Humidity: 90%. Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) Clause. The following AMC clause will form part of the contract p laced on successful Bidder:- (a) The Seller would provide comprehensive AMC for a period of four years. The AMC services shoul d cover the repair and maintenance of all the equipment and systems purchased under the present Contra ct. The Buyer Furnished Equipment which is not covered under the purview of the AMC should be separatel y listed by the Seller. The AMC services would be provided in two distinct ways: (i) Preventive Maintenance Service. The Seller will provide a minimum of four Preventive Mainten ance Service visits during a year to the operating base to carry out functional checkups and minor adjustm ents/ tuning as may be required. (ii) Breakdown Maintenance Service. In case of any breakdown of the equipment/system, on recei ving a call from the Buyer, the Seller is to provide maintenance service to make the equipment/system ser viceable. (b) Response time: The response time of the Seller should not exceed 24 hours from the time the bre akdown intimation is provided by the Buyer. (c) Serviceability of 90% per year is to be ensured. This amounts to total maximum downtime of 18 da ys per year. Also serviceability should not exceed four days at one time. Required spares to attain this ser viceability may be stored at site by the Seller at his own cost. Total down time would be calculated at the end of the year. If downtime exceeds permitted downtime, LD would be applicable for the delayed period. (d) Maximum repair turnaround time for equipment/system would be four days. However, the spares s hould be maintained in a serviceable condition to avoid complete breakdown of the equipment/system.

(e) Technical Documentation. All necessary changes in the documentation (Technical and Operators manual) for changes carried out on hardware and software of the equipment will be provided. (f) During the AMC period, the Seller shall carry out all necessary servicing/repairs to the equipment/s ystem under AMC at the current location of the equipment/system. Prior permission of the Buyer would be required in case certain components/sub systems are to be shifted out of location. On such occasions, befo re taking over the goods or components, the Seller will give suitable bank guarantee to the Buyer to cover the estimated current value of item being taken. (g) The Buyer reserves its right to terminate the maintenance contract at any time without assigning a ny reason after giving a notice of one month. The Seller will not be entitled to claim any compensation aga inst such termination. However, while terminating the contract, if any payment is due to the Seller for mai ntenance services already performed in terms of the contract, the same would be paid to it as per the cont ract terms. .
